description: This file defines the 'Token' class used for tokenizing expressions in a Java expression evaluator, including token types, factory methods, and type checks.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a token in an expression, with types such as operator, function, literal, brackets, and separator.

methods.name: buildLiteral
methods.description: Creates a literal token with a string value.

methods.name: buildOperator
methods.description: Creates an operator token with an Operator object.

methods.name: buildFunction
methods.description: Creates a function token with a Function object.

methods.name: buildOpenToken
methods.description: Creates an open bracket token with a BracketPair object.

methods.name: buildCloseToken
methods.description: Creates a close bracket token with a BracketPair object.

methods.name: getBrackets
methods.description: Returns the BracketPair associated with an open or close bracket token.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the Operator object associated with an operator token.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Returns the Function object associated with a function token.

methods.name: getKind
methods.description: Returns the kind/type of the token.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Checks if the token is an operator.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Checks if the token is a function.

methods.name: isOpenBracket
methods.description: Checks if the token is an open bracket.

methods.name: isCloseBracket
methods.description: Checks if the token is a close bracket.

methods.name: isFunctionArgumentSeparator
methods.description: Checks if the token is a function argument separator.

methods.name: isLiteral
methods.description: Checks if the token is a literal.

methods.name: getAssociativity
methods.description: Returns the associativity of the operator token.

methods.name: getPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the precedence of the operator token.

methods.name: getLiteral
methods.description: Returns the literal string value of a literal token.

methods.name: getBooleanHackedLiteral
methods.description: Returns '1' for true, '0' for false, or the literal value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.
